clips.title: The story
paras: Deep beneath Westfall, Ironclad Cove holds a hidden shipyard and dock. The Defias Brotherhood builds its war juggernaught here, with a passage to the sea.

Ironclad Cove lies at the deepest point of the Deadmines, where a vast sea cavern has become a fortified dockyard. Edwin VanCleef and the Defias Brotherhood have built an enormous warship here, the juggernaught. Wooden scaffolding, islets, and loading catwalks fill the cavern, watched by Defias pirates, deckhands, and overseers. VanCleef aims to do more than raid Westfall's farmsteads: he plans to assemble a private naval force capable of bombarding Stormwind's shores.
